notes.title: v1.2 bugfix
notes.notes:
In the latest patch 1.2 (available for base game and DLC), the lone typo has been fixed. Also, the game has been updated to use the latest version of Ren'Py.

Thank you for all of your ongoing support! :D

notes.title: v1.1 bugfix
notes.notes: Hi there! the head well lost has been updated to version 1.1, which fixes several instances where unique character names weren't working (mostly in text messages). You should be able to see your specified name everywhere in the game instead of "Francis" if you choose one. Please let me know if that is not the case!
